qualification.details: Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma /MD /MS from a recognized University or equivalent. OR 3 years of research, teaching and design and development experience after MSc/MVSc/M.Pharm/ME/M.Tech with at least one research paper in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. Desirable: prior research experience in plant protein extraction, quantification, quality assessment, proteome profiling through LC-MS, publications in plant protein extraction and proteome profiling, hands-on experience in LC-MS and data interpretation, proficiency in scientific writing and lab management.

Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Gujarat Biotechnology University to complete the application.

Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Associate I position at Gujarat Biotechnology University?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the Research Associate I position is 05-10-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma /MD /MS from a recognized University or equivalent, or have 3 years of relevant experience with a research paper in an SCI journal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate I recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate I position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 58000 Per Month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for the Research Associate I position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate I position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Research Associate I post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Research Associate I post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of Gujarat Biotechnology University?
faq.answer: The official website of Gujarat Biotechnology University is www.gbu.edu.in.
